primary.title: SIP vs lump sum: Which strategy delivers higher mutual fund returns? Global 30-yr data reveals what worked better
primary.summary: SIP investments outperformed lump-sum investing in six of 10 major global equity markets over 30 years, according to DSP Mutual Fund. Japan recorded the biggest SIP advantage, while Brazil delivered higher returns through lump-sum investments.
